svg.title: The 45-minute system design round as a clock face, with a time box for each stage
svg.desc: Minutes 0 to 3 hello and the question; 3 to 8 requirements; 8 to 10 core entities; 10 to 15 API; 15 to 30 high-level design, with data flow folded in when the question is a pipeline; 30 to 40 deep dives; 40 to 45 your questions. A marker at minute 30 says an end-to-end design must exist by then.
svg.text: the 45-minute round, one stage at a time
data flow fits in here when needed
